# modelpace

> Zero-dependency Node.js (>= 22) CLI and MCP server that recommends which T3 Code provider instance and model should take a delegated task, from live quota pacing (Even Pace, reset credits) and past acceptance records. It only advises; the calling agent still runs `delegate_task`.

Start with AGENTS.md: it covers install, the validate / plan / record loop, MCP setup for Claude Code and Codex, data and privacy, and troubleshooting. Commands in this index are runnable from a clone with `node ./bin/modelpace.mjs`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/AGENTS.md): guide for coding agents — install, commands, MCP tools, privacy, troubleshooting
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/README.md): overview, quick start, policy, ledger and T3 connection
- [Schema reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/docs/SCHEMA.md): config, record and snapshot fields with examples
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/skills/modelpace/SKILL.md): when and how to plan before and record after `delegate_task`
- [中文 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview

## Examples

- [Sample snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/examples/sample-snapshot.json): usage snapshot for the built-in policy (replay with `--now 2026-11-23T07:05:00Z`)
- [Record template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/examples/record.example.json): a complete acceptance record
- [Multi-account config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/examples/multi-account.config.json): two Antigravity subscriptions plus Codex and Claude
- [Multi-account snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jieyuexing/modelpace/main/examples/multi-account.snapshot.json): matching snapshot for that config
